description: Search currently open public tenders for Ukraine's reconstruction (World Bank, EU TED, EBRD, Prozorro). Returns title (English headline), issuer, sector, region, estimated value, deadline and links to the page on Ukraine Builders and the official notice.

min_value_usd.description: Only tenders with an estimated value of at least this many US dollars (approximate, UAH at about 41 per USD).

query.description: Words to look for in the title or issuer, e.g. "boiler" or "school Kharkiv".

name: search_tenders
